title: Find Score of an Array After Marking All Elements
summary: Given an array of positive integers, initialize a score to 0.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, initialize a score to 0. Select the smallest unmarked number, add its value to the score, and mark it along with its adjacent elements. Continue until all elements are marked. Return the final score.
constraints: Repeatedly select the smallest unmarked value, breaking ties by smallest index.
Add it to the score and mark that index and its existing neighbors.
Return the score after every index is marked.
reference_solution:
def score_after_marking(nums):
    import heapq
    heap=[(value,index) for index,value in enumerate(nums)];heapq.heapify(heap);marked=set();score=0
    while heap:
        value,index=heapq.heappop(heap)
        if index in marked:continue
        score+=value;marked.update((index-1,index,index+1))
    return score

def score_after_marking(nums):
    import heapq
    heap=[(value,index) for index,value in enumerate(nums)];heapq.heapify(heap);marked=set();score=0
    while heap:
        value,index=heapq.heappop(heap)
